zh: 修复 DECK 主题偶尔显示不出卡带或光盘贴图的问题。贴图恢复可读后会重新加载，切换游戏时会保留静帧，直到新的 3D 画面就绪。
修复没有本地 ROM 的游戏在远端 ROM 确认缺失后仍留在普通列表的问题。远端 ROM 恢复后，游戏会重新显示。
修复远端 ROM 状态未知或部分媒体已经删除时，剩余远端资料无法清理的问题。游戏从列表隐藏后，仍可在「设置 → 游戏库与文件夹 → 剩余远端资料」管理封面、视频和游戏资料。
社区主题、语言包和插件在 GitHub 和 GHFast 都无法连接时，可以继续尝试备用镜像。
en: Fixed missing cartridge and disc artwork in the DECK theme. Artwork reloads when it becomes available, and a still image remains visible until the new 3D frame is ready.
Fixed games with no local ROM remaining in the library after their remote ROM was confirmed missing. They reappear when the remote ROM is restored.

Fixed cleanup of remaining cloud media when the remote ROM status is unknown or some media has already been removed. After a game is hidden, manage its covers, videos, and metadata under Settings → Game Library and Folders → Remaining Cloud Media and Metadata.
Community themes, language packs, and plugins can now use a backup mirror if GitHub and GHFast are both unreachable.
